div.div: 🇳🇵 BOTE YOUTH COMMUNITY • PRIME NEPALI FLAG THEME
div.h1:
Preserving Our River Heritage,
Empowering Bote Youth
div.p: Official portal of the Bote Community of Karmaiya, Sarlahi District, Nepal. Safeguarding our ancient single-log canoe craft, revitalizing the endangered Tarahi Bote language, and funding education for the next generation.

div.strong: Official Bote Youth Community Online Services
div.small: Join the community, apply for education support, share your voice, and request community assistance online.

div.div: Explore heritage, language, craftsmanship, council leaders, and digital identity through interconnected Bento modules.

div.span: INDIGENOUS HERITAGE • Karmaiya, Sarlahi • Bagmati River
div.h3: REVITALIZING ANCIENT WATER TRADITIONS & YOUTH LEADERSHIP
div.p: The Bote indigenous community honors ancestral river navigation, single-log dugout canoes (Ek-Dunge Nau), and sacred water rites while educating the next generation of Nepali leaders.
Sacred offerings to river deities ensuring safe boat passage and rich fish harvests.
Preserve an endangered oral dialect with searchable words and phonetic pronunciation.

div.div: From the banks of the Bagmati River in Karmaiya, Sarlahi to settlements across inner-Terai Nepal, our community unites to protect indigenous identity.

div.p: The legend of the tree trunk origin, river ferry kings, and the single-log dugout canoe.
Sansari Devi Puja, Jal Puja, Maghe Sankranti boat races, and animist water worship.
Save the endangered Tarahi Bote dialect with a searchable community lexicon.
Traditional Gunya, Cholo, Hansuli necklaces, Bulaki nose rings, and Kalli anklets.

div.div: Dedicated representatives steering cultural preservation, legal recognition, and education scholarships across Karmaiya, Sarlahi District.
